messages:
maria: FYI — PR #4521 opened, touches auth for on‑prem agents and secret handling. Need security sign-off before tonight's merge window. Diff: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4521
sam: quick q — what's the change surface? auth flow + secret storage? any new network calls to customer VPCs?
maria: short summary:
- switch to envelope encryption with customer KMS endpoint if configured
- fallback to encrypted local keystore for air‑gapped installs
- adds `ONPREM_KMS_ENDPOINT` and `ONPREM_KEY_ID` env vars
- updates auth handshake to include mutual TLS when enabled
I'll paste the code snippets below.
sam: ok, sounds risky — can you highlight where we validate the KMS endpoint is customer-owned?
maria: we do thumbprint + allowed-cidrs check in `auth/onprem/handshake.go` (line ~120). also added a knob `REJECT_UNKNOWN_KMS=true`.
toni: @maria thanks. I can take this. please run the SCA + secret-scan and attach reports. also add a short migration note for customers re: key rotation.
security-bot: SCA scan: 0 critical, 1 medium (test fixture with plain token). Secret scan: 0 high. Link: https://scans.local/1976543210
maria: removing fixture token now, will push within 10m :thumbsup:
toni: also add a deployment gate in the onprem pipeline to prevent auto-merge until security label is present. example:
```
jobs:
  - name: require-security-approval
    if: contains(labels, 'security-review') == false
    action: fail
```
please add that to `.github/workflows/onprem-deploy.yml`.
leo: cc'ing infra for KMS egress rules — @devops can we allow outbound 443 to customer KMS endpoints only? :eyes:
devops: we can add egress policy, but need the list of endpoints or CIDR ranges. prefer DNS allowlist + mTLS.
maria: I'll add config docs and a template customer-kms.json with example CIDRs.
toni: last ask — add a short privacy note about telemetry: ensure we don't log any plaintext keys or endpoints. then I'll approve.
maria: got it, adding telemetry scrub and tests. ping me if I should wait to merge until you approve.
toni: please hold merge until I ack. thanks :pray:
